definition.intent: Mostrar ao gestor as despesas da equipe que estão esperando análise, para ele perceber de imediato o que precisa decidir.

sections.purpose: Reunir na área principal a caixa de entrada das despesas da equipe que ainda aguardam decisão.

caixaEntradaDespesas.text: Comunica as despesas da equipe que ainda esperam a análise do gestor, para ele saber o que precisa decidir agora e seguir para a análise.

definition.intent: Mostrar em coluna fluida e estreita, em torno de 390px e usável em 360px e 430px, as despesas da equipe que esperam análise, para o gestor ver o que precisa decidir.

sections.purpose: Empilhar em leitura contínua e estreita, fluida em torno de 390px e usável em 360px e 430px, a caixa de entrada das despesas pendentes da equipe.

caixaEntradaDespesas.text: Comunica em leitura estreita as despesas da equipe que ainda esperam análise, para o gestor identificar o que precisa decidir mesmo em tela estreita e seguir para a análise.

answer.categoryReason: A página Início do gestor é só a caixa de entrada das despesas da equipe que pedem atenção, sem escrita nesta tela; activityNotificationHub descreve esse hub de pendências.

groups.reason: A pending expense can require a binary decision such as approve or reject after analysis.
The inbox describes reviewing pending expenses, not entering a date.
No date-range entry or date-based filtering is requested.
Reviewing expenses does not require entering a date and time.
No exact start/end timestamp interval is part of the expense-review task.
Expense amounts need to be displayed for review, but the request does not indicate entering or editing monetary values.
No numeric value must be entered to see and decide on pending expenses.
The request does not call for filtering or entering a bounded numeric range.
A reviewer may need to enter a comment or justification when making a decision on an expense.
No time-only input is required for the pending-expense inbox.
No recurring or bounded time interval is part of reviewing expenses.
Expense rows can expose receipt, policy, and submission details progressively while keeping the inbox compact.
The task does not require providing or viewing geographic location.
The description specifies one inbox view, without a need to switch among in-context sections.
Analyzing and deciding on expenses is not described as a sequential multi-step flow.
The interface should confirm or report success/failure after the reviewer decides on an expense.
Playing audio or video is unrelated to viewing and deciding pending expenses.
The reviewer must make a business decision, not assign a rating or score.
Capturing QR codes, barcodes, or documents by camera is not needed to review the listed expenses.
Search helps the reviewer locate a specific team expense within the pending inbox.
The reviewer is viewing submitted expenses; uploading files is not part of the stated task.
The request does not state that multiple expenses need to be selected for a bulk operation.
A reviewer can choose one mutually exclusive outcome, such as approve, reject, or request adjustment, for an expense.
No long-running operation or process whose progress must be shown is described.
The reviewer needs explicit commands to submit decisions or open an expense for analysis.
A card can present an individual pending expense with summary information and decision actions.
The task is operational review of individual pending expenses, not graphical data analysis.
The inbox must display a collection of pending team-expense records with relevant details.
Pending expenses are not described as parent-child hierarchical data.
A highlighted KPI is not necessary to see the pending expenses and decide on them.
A table is suitable for comparing multiple pending expenses by employee, amount, date, status, and available decision actions.
